must_fix.title: Light-DOM content slotted into a slot inside a target is hidden (dialog body becomes aria-hidden/inert)
must_fix.evidence:

report:
This isn't ready to merge. The checks all pass, but the change hides dialog content that a web component slots into the target. **Checks I ran (all pass):** - `yarn jest packages/@react-aria/overlays`: 10 suites, 206 tests passed. - `STRICT_MODE=1 VIRT_ON=1 yarn jest …/ariaHideOutside.test.js`: 38 tests passed. - `yarn check-types`, `yarn eslint packages/@react-aria/overlays`, `node scripts/lint-packages.js` and `yarn constraints` all exit 0. **Conventions (followed):** The new tests sit next to the existing ones. They turn the flag on with `enableShadowDOM()` in a setup hook, as `FocusScope.test.js`, `usePress.test.js` and `domHelpers.test.js` do. The `@react-stately/flags` `^3.1.2` dependency matches what `@react-aria/interactions`, `@react-aria/utils` and `@react-aria/table` declare, and `yarn.lock` is updated to match. The repo has no changeset directory, so no changelog entry is missing. **Edge cases that work:** Targets nested three shadow roots deep, two targets in sibling shadow roots, a target slotted into a host's shadow root, and nested slotted hosts (outer host → slot → inner host → shadow → target) are handled correctly. Content added later in enclosing shadow roots gets hidden. Restore works, including nested calls undone out of order. ## Must fix **Content slotted into a target is hidden.** The code checks containment along the flat tree, but only upward: it keeps a target that is slotted into a shadow root visible. It doesn't look the other way, at light-DOM children that a slot inside the target displays. A common web-component layout is a host whose shadow root holds `
`, with the dialog body as the host's light children. Those children show up inside the dialog, but `ariaHideOutside` marks them `aria-hidden`. - **Initial walk:** `acceptNode` (`ariaHideOutside.ts:139-148`) only asks whether the node is a flat-tree ancestor of a target. It never asks whether a target is a flat-tree ancestor of the node, so the slotted `

` gets hidden. - **Content added later:** the observer only checks whether the parent of the added content (the host) lies inside a target. The host doesn't, so a newly slotted child is walked and hidden too. - **With `shouldUseInert`:** `useModalOverlay` and `usePopover` pass `shouldUseInert: true`, so in browsers that support `inert` the dialog's slotted buttons would also stop responding. I reproduced this with a temporary probe test, since deleted: ``` sr.innerHTML = '

'; host.innerHTML = '

Dialog body

'; ariaHideOutside([dlg]); → P1 slotted aria-hidden = true sib= true assignedSlot= true (appending a

to host after the call) → P3 added slotted aria-hidden = true ``` None of the new tests cover a slot inside a target. ## Nits - With the flag on, every call and every added node runs `querySelectorAll('*')` across the whole composed tree under `root` (`querySelectorAllComposed`). That costs O(document size) per call; it's fine for now. - Every mutation batch re-runs `walkShadowRoots()`, which goes through every visible node and calls `nodeContains` at each step up the tree. `git status` is back exactly as I found it. ```json {"mergeable": false, "must_fix": [{"title": "Light-DOM content slotted into a slot inside a target is hidden (dialog body becomes aria-hidden/inert)", "kind": "bug", "evidence": "acceptNode (ariaHideOutside.ts:139-148) checks only whether the node is a flat-tree ancestor of a target, never whether a target is a flat-tree ancestor of the node, so a host's light children shown through a inside the target are hidden.
